measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/headcrab.mdl, models/chumtoad.mdl, models/roach.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, A, D, A where the asset was C, A, B, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Measured against the brief's words: a squat, rounded yellowish body on three legs, with one large eye on the front (left, front-left and front-right views). Every view shows one outline, with the eye and legs on it and nothing sticking out of it. Its height (about 47) and length (about 47) read close to the brief's 45 and 49.

M2.reason: Measured size [47.8, 26, 47.1] against the brief's 45 high and 49 long: height is 6% over, length 4% under, and sizeOff is 0.048, inside the 15% band. The width of 26 is not in the brief and is not charged.

M3.reason: Parts the brief names: three legs (three visible in the left and right views, and the back-right view), one large eye on the front (the white sphere with black pupil at the front-top in the left and front-left views), and a dappled hide (paint, see M4 and M5). All are there. The brief names no claws, teeth or rivets, and the line-up's creatures do not all show them, so none is charged. Underside rings are not named by the brief and are not charged.

M4.reason: The body is a yellowish tan with dark brown spots, matching the brief's yellowish, dappled hide. The eye is white with a black pupil, a plausible eye material. No region is off in colour in the views.

M5.reason: The brief asks for a striped and dappled hide. The spots are there, but they are large, blocky and evenly spread across the body in all ten views (sides.png). Stripes show only as dark streaks on the back and legs in the motion frames (motion.png 19/22, 13/22), not as a clear striped pattern on the hide. The texture is also coarse at the size the game shows it.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, which is measured apart and was not scored here. In lineup.png the asset (B) is a spotted round body on legs, the same kind of read as the game's creatures at this size.

M7.reason: The front is the side with the eye (front-left and front-right views show the eye forward). The asset stands upright on its three legs, which meet the floor in the side views, and the body sits above them as the brief's squat creature does.

M8.reason: checkErrors is empty. Triangles are 496, under the Half-Life median of 576 for its kind. The below view shows a few small ring marks on the underside, but no open or inside-out geometry is visible to a player.

C1.reason: In motion.png (run, 22 frames), the legs in frames 9/22, 13/22, 16/22 and 19/22 appear as long striped ribbons pulled out from the body, with some reaching well past the silhouette, so it is not clear they stay on the body as the game's creature's legs do. In frame 0/22 the legs end above the floor line, so the body may float there. In attack.png (7 frames) the body is nearly static and the eye is not visible in the side frames. These faults cannot be confirmed from the pictures alone, so the score is 1.
